screening.sample_type: R&D technical professionals (scientists, engineers, technicians) in high technology industries
screening.empirical_bsb_construct: Empirical individual-level boundary spanning activity measured via intraunit and extraunit communication frequency
screening.reasoning: The dissertation empirically measures individual-level boundary spanning activity and its sub-facet extraunit communication frequency among R&D professionals across six high-technology firms. A complete zero-order correlation matrix is reported in Table 3.9.

study_details.title: Dual Commitment and Boundary Spanning Activity of R&D Professionals

table_matrix.cot_reasoning: Table 3.9 (p. 131 / PDF p. 151) is a landscape table presenting a lower triangular matrix of zero-order Pearson intercorrelations among 19 variables for N = 253. The upper diagonal is empty, and diagonal unities are omitted. Footnote a defines significance thresholds: absolute values of .12 and above are significant at p < .05, and absolute values of .17 and above are significant at p < .01. In accordance with Extraction Rule 7, both the global composite construct ('1. BSA') and the specific external sub-facet ('3. External Com.') are extracted, while intra-unit communication ('2. Internal Com.') is classified as 'NB'. Demographic variables (4. Age, 5. Sex, 6. Tenure) are pruned from substantive pairings.

measure_details.items_quote: This was done by obtaining percentile ranking of subjects on intraunit and extraunit communication activity scores and using the mean of the two ranks as the boundary spanning score.

measure_details.items_quote: Extraunit communication frequency was measured by asking subjects to report frequency of work-related communication on a six-point scale (0=never, 1=about once a month, 2=less than once a week, 3=about once a week, 4=more than once a week, 5=almost every day) with each of 12 categories of individuals over the past month.
measure_details.source_quote: Extraunit communication frequency is the second component of boundary spanning behavior.

measure_details.items_quote: Subjects were asked about communication frequency within the last month with every other technical professional in the unit, using a 6-point Likert-type scale (0=never, 1=about once a month, 2=less than once a week, 3=about once a week, 4=more than once a week, 5=almost every day).
measure_details.source_quote: Intraunit communication frequency is one of the two components of boundary spanning activity.
